data_description.supplier: Select your energy supplier. Choose 'Other' for non-EDF providers.

supplier_custom.title: Custom supplier
supplier_custom.description: You chose Other as your energy supplier. Enter a short name for dashboards and entity labels (for example the name on your bill). Tariffs are entered manually when there is no automatic feed for this provider. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-supplier_custom)

data_description.supplier_custom_name: Required. A brand name or abbreviation is enough.

tariff_mode.title: Tariff retrieval mode
tariff_mode.description: Choose how tariffs should be configured. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-tariff_mode)

data_description.tariff_mode: Auto: fetch tariffs from provider API. Manual: enter rates yourself.

tariff_mode_manual_only.title: Tariff configuration
tariff_mode_manual_only.description: Automatic tariff retrieval is not yet available for this supplier. Rates must be entered manually. If auto-retrieval becomes available later, a migration path will be provided without affecting historical data. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-tariff_mode_manual_only)

contract.title: Contract details
contract.description: Enter your subscribed power (kVA) and an optional contract label. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-contract)

edf_offer.title: EDF offer selection
edf_offer.description: Choose how your EDF offer is priced: BASE, HPHC, or Tempo. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-edf_offer)

edf_tempo.title: Tempo signal source
edf_tempo.description: RTE is the most reliable source but requires credentials. API Couleur Tempo works without credentials and is easier to set up. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-edf_tempo)

edf_tempo_rte.title: RTE credentials
edf_tempo_rte.description: Enter your RTE API credentials to fetch the Tempo calendar from the official source. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-edf_tempo_rte)

manual_pricing.title: Pricing structure
manual_pricing.description: Choose how your manual tariff is modeled. Pick the option that best matches how your bill is structured. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-manual_pricing)

data_description.pricing_structure: Single rate: one kWh price. Peak/off-peak: time windows with different prices (e.g. off-peak nights). Advanced: slots per day type.

manual_flat.title: Flat tariff
manual_flat.description: Enter your single kWh energy price and optional monthly subscription. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-manual_flat)

manual_tou.title: Time-of-use tariff
manual_tou.description: Define off-peak (HC) and peak (HP) windows and their kWh prices. Use advanced schedule for more than two bands. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-manual_tou)

manual_schedule.title: Advanced schedule
manual_schedule.description: Choose how to enter your tariff slots. Full JSON format and examples: {doc_url} [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-manual_schedule)

manual_schedule_form.title: Advanced schedule — form
manual_schedule_form.description: Fill one row per slot (up to 6). Leave unused rows empty. See {doc_url} for midnight ranges and day types. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-manual_schedule_form)

manual_schedule_json.title: Advanced schedule — JSON
manual_schedule_json.description: Paste a JSON array of slots. Specification: {doc_url} [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-manual_schedule_json)

grid_tri_energy_mode.title: Three-phase grid import
grid_tri_energy_mode.description: Does your installation expose one total import counter for the whole grid, or one counter per phase? [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-grid_tri_energy_mode)

data_description.grid_tri_energy_mode: One total: you will pick a single import sensor next. One per phase: the integration sums L1+L2+L3 for accounting.

grid_tri_per_phase.title: Three-phase import meters
grid_tri_per_phase.description: Select one import energy sensor per phase. Optional: three export sensors (all or none). [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-grid_tri_per_phase)

data.tri_export_energy_p1: Phase L1 — grid export energy (kWh, optional)
data.tri_export_energy_p2: Phase L2 — grid export energy (kWh, optional)
data.tri_export_energy_p3: Phase L3 — grid export energy (kWh, optional)

data_description.grid_power_sign_mode: Convention: is export negative or positive on your per-phase grid power sensors?
data_description.load_power_sensor: Optional house consumption for load-side diagnostics.
data_description.tri_grid_power_p1: Instantaneous power on L1; the integration sums whichever phases you set for real-time display. For a single total sensor, fill only one phase.

grid.title: Grid energy sensors
grid.description: Configure your grid energy measurement sensors. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-grid)

data_description.grid_import_energy: Total increasing energy counter for grid import.
data_description.grid_export_energy: Total increasing energy counter for grid export (if separate from import).
data_description.grid_power_sensor: Instantaneous grid power for real-time display.
data_description.grid_power_sign_mode: Convention: is export negative or positive on this sensor?

grid_tri_layout.title: Three-phase sensor layout
grid_tri_layout.description: Choose how you want to enter optional per-phase sensors (import/export energy and grid power). Your main grid sensors from the previous step stay as the primary totals. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-grid_tri_layout)

data_description.grid_tri_sensor_layout: One for all phases: next step uses JSON lists (one total or multiple phases). One per phase: the next three steps ask for phase L1, L2, and L3 separately.

grid_phases.title: Three-phase grid sensors (JSON)
grid_phases.description: Optional JSON lists: either one entry for a total sensor or one entry per phase (see template). Leave fields empty to skip. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-grid_phases)

tri_grid_phase_1.title: Three-phase grid — phase L1
tri_grid_phase_1.description: Optional sensors for phase 1. Leave a field empty if you do not have it. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-tri_grid_phase_1)

tri_grid_phase_2.title: Three-phase grid — phase L2
tri_grid_phase_2.description: Optional sensors for phase 2. Leave a field empty if you do not have it. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-tri_grid_phase_2)

tri_grid_phase_3.title: Three-phase grid — phase L3
tri_grid_phase_3.description: Optional sensors for phase 3. Leave a field empty if you do not have it. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-tri_grid_phase_3)

solar.title: Solar configuration

data_description.solar_energy: Total increasing energy counter for solar production.
data_description.solar_power_sensor: Improves real-time power display and power-balance diagnostics.
data_description.solar_export_tariff: Re-sale price per kWh for exported solar energy.

solar.description: Say whether you want to track solar production in this integration. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-solar)

solar_config.title: Solar configuration
solar_config.description: Select the solar production sensors. Optional: resale and estimation. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-solar_config)

data_description.solar_energy: Total increasing energy counter for solar production.
data_description.solar_power_sensor: Improves real-time power display and power-balance diagnostics.
data_description.solar_resale_contract: Enable if you have a contract that pays you for exported solar energy.
data_description.solar_export_tariff: Re-sale price per kWh for exported solar energy.
data_description.solar_estimation_enabled: Adds an estimation model to complement real solar measurements.

solar_estimation.title: Solar production estimation
solar_estimation.description: Optional: configure PV estimation when you enable it. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-solar_estimation)

battery.title: Battery systems
battery.description: Say whether you want to track home battery systems. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-battery)

battery_add.title: Add battery system
battery_add.description: Configure a battery/inverter system. Only charge and discharge energy sensors are required. If you enable advanced fields, the next step will ask for optional capacity, power limits, and SOC bounds. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-battery_add)

data_description.batt_power_in: Instantaneous power currently going into the battery (not a max value).
data_description.batt_power_out: Instantaneous power currently drawn from the battery (not a max value).
data_description.batt_power_net: Use this if you have a single signed sensor instead of separate charge/discharge. If you set charge + discharge sensors, you can leave this empty.
data_description.batt_power_net_sign: Only needed if you use a net power sensor.
data_description.batt_soc: Optional percentage sensor (0–100). Used for the SOC bar and ETA.
data_description.batt_advanced: Opens a separate step for nominal capacity (kWh), charge/discharge limits (W), and SOC min/max.

battery_advanced.title: Battery advanced settings
battery_advanced.description: Battery #{battery_number}: for each setting, two rows share the same title: first a sensor/helper, then a manual value. Only fill one of the two rows (not both). [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-battery_advanced)

data.batt_max_charge_w_entity: Max charge power — sensor or helper
data.batt_max_discharge_w_entity: Max discharge power — sensor or helper

data_description.batt_capacity_kwh_entity: Nominal capacity at 100% SOC (max storable energy, kWh). Numeric value in kWh (e.g. sensor, input_number). Use when the value comes from an entity.
data_description.batt_capacity_kwh: Nominal capacity at 100% SOC (max storable energy, kWh). Enter here or use the entity above — only one of the two.
data_description.batt_max_charge_w_entity: Technical limit in W read from an entity.
data_description.batt_max_charge_w: Technical limit in W (not your instantaneous measured power).
data_description.batt_max_discharge_w_entity: Technical limit in W read from an entity.
data_description.batt_max_discharge_w: Technical limit in W (not your instantaneous measured power).
data_description.batt_soc_min: Use if the battery never reaches 0%.
data_description.batt_soc_max: Use if the battery never reaches 100%.

battery_more.title: More batteries?
battery_more.description: You can add more battery systems or continue. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-battery_more)

reinjection.title: Advanced reinjection tuning
reinjection.description: Optional advanced thresholds for export / reinjection classification. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-reinjection)

error.battery_adv_max_discharge_not_both: Choose either a max discharge entity or a manual max discharge value.

error.tariff_fetch_failed: Failed to fetch tariffs from provider API.
error.tariff_payload_incomplete: Tariff data from the provider was incomplete or invalid. Try again or check offer and kVA.
error.no_energy_sensor: At least one grid energy sensor is required.
error.tri_export_all_or_none: Either leave all three export phase sensors empty or configure all three.
error.tri_import_phases_incomplete: Configure import energy sensors for all three phases (L1, L2, L3).
error.schedule_incomplete_row: Each slot needs both start and end times, or leave the row empty.
error.invalid_delta_cap: Delta caps must be finite numbers within the allowed range.

advanced_energy.title: Energy delta caps
advanced_energy.description: Maximum positive kWh change accepted in a single update per source class. Larger jumps are treated as unrealistic (skipped for internal totals; last meter reading still updates). Grid applies to import and export. [Documentation — energy delta caps](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc#configure-delta-caps).

data_description.max_delta_kwh_grid: Ceiling for one update on grid counters. Raise it if Home Assistant was off and the meter moved more than this before the next poll.
data_description.max_delta_kwh_solar: Same for the PV kWh meter—stops one bad spike from booking a huge amount at once.
data_description.max_delta_kwh_battery: Applies to each battery charge/discharge counter configured in the integration.
data_description.max_delta_kwh_other: Fallback cap for any other hub energy source not covered above.

tempo.title: Tempo signal source
tempo.description: Choose between RTE (official) and API Couleur Tempo. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-options-tempo)

tempo_rte.title: RTE credentials
tempo_rte.description: Enter your RTE API credentials. Leave secret empty to keep the existing one. [Step help](https://hub-energie.ts-devops.com/#/doc/setup-help#flow-step-options-tempo_rte)
